svg.aria-label: Campaign Engine: four job sources feed a market scan, results are scored, a recruiter decides, delivery is verified. Over 1,000 jobs matched in the first month; 10 mailboxes, 30 mails per mailbox per day.
svg.title: Campaign Engine
